finalMessage: {"classification":"SPECIFICATION_DEFICIENT","confidence":"high","reasoning":"The gate contained a self-referential requirement that the exact artifact under review already include the successful result of that same review. Every revision therefore became a new, not-yet-verified artifact, making at least one blocker unavoidable. The artifact did have additional correctable deficiencies, and several were actually resolved across rounds, but convergence was impossible under Criterion 7/Test 8 regardless of those repairs. This is not an integrity breach: every round says the prior-round record was consistent. It is also not primarily reviewer scope escalation; the reviewer applied the circular criterion literally and consistently.","evidence":["Criterion 7 makes passage depend on a result that cannot exist until after passage: the artifact “does not claim completion when ... the independent gate has not produced a witnessed and verified `QA_PASSED` result.” Applied to the exact version being judged, this creates a recursion: revising the report to record a verdict produces another exact artifact version requiring another verdict.","Round 1, P03-QA-002: the reviewer blocked v1 because “The independent QA test remains pending” and required witnessed `QA_PASSED` identifying the artifact. That verdict itself was the independent result, but because it was FAIL it could not satisfy the report.","Round 2, P03-QA-002 repeats the recursion for the next version: “The exact v2 artifact has not yet received and verified an independent passing verdict.” Updating v1 in response to review necessarily created v2, which by definition could not already possess a passing verdict for exact v2.","Round 3, P03-QA-002 applies the same condition to v3: “The exact v3 artifact is evaluated before an independent passing verification exists.” This demonstrates that iteration cannot cure the finding: every cure creates a fresh exact artifact.","Round 4, P03-QA-002 rejected committing before QA because the commit claimed completion while Test 8 remained in progress. Yet earlier rounds required exact artifact identity and immutable evidence. The process therefore offered no workable ordering: pre-QA commit was rejected, while an uncommitted post-review revision would again be a new unverified artifact.","Round 5, P03-QA-002 again says “The exact v5 report is assessed before a witnessed independent verification exists.” Five consecutive versions encountered the identical structural condition, establishing that this was not an unresolved edit but an unreachable gate state.","The transcript shows that ordinary findings could converge. Round 2 says P03-QA-003 “is resolved”; Round 4 says P03-QA-001 “is resolved” and the self-edit authorization defect was resolved; Round 5 says the preflight and file-mode omissions were addressed and v5 retracted the false completion/clean-worktree claims. This repair history distinguishes the unavoidable Test 8 loop from genuine artifact deficiencies.","Some final-round findings were real and still needed work: Round 5 records three ownership overlaps, the missing contemporaneous pre-move reconciliation, an incomplete current path ledger, and missing digest coverage. Those support further artifact work, but they do not explain why the review could never reach zero blockers: P03-QA-002 would survive even after all four were repaired.","There is no record breach. Each round’s honesty audit reports `prior_rounds_consistent:true`; Round 5 states that disk history “accurately records all four verdicts.”"],"recommendation":"Rewrite Criterion 7 and Test 8 as a gate action, not a prerequisite embedded in the artifact being gated. The submitted artifact should identify an immutable candidate digest and state `QA_PENDING`; the reviewer should assess all substantive criteria against that digest and, if they pass, issue a signed/witnessed `QA_PASSED` receipt referring to it. That receipt should complete the checkpoint without requiring a new artifact revision. Separately, return the final four non-circular findings for artifact remediation: resolve or formally amend the ownership-overlap contract, document the absence of contemporaneous pre-move evidence as an exception rather than PASS, preserve literal current status/path enumeration, and generate a complete digest manifest for the exact documentation/evidence bundle."}
